name: AmuseWiki
description_en: Amusewiki is based on the Emacs Muse markup, remaining mostly compatible with the original implementation. It can work as a read-only site, as a moderated wiki, or as a fully open wiki or even as a private site. ([Demo](https://sandbox.amusewiki.org), [Source Code](https://github.com/melmothx/amusewiki)) `GPL-1.0` `Perl/Docker`
